MerlinVerify.Check.Bf16F32AccBoundary.check_sound

title: Ordered unrolling
boundary: The actual source loop → the Python producer's unrolled loop, before tensor preprocessing.
example:
Dynamic outer loop stays in place.
Its inner 5 iterations become 2 groups × 2 lanes + 1 tail.
Zero outer trips still execute no inner work.
claim: Equal returned values, modeled errors and terminal world, under the common scalar/SCF interpretation.
limit: Explicit one-based depth; static selected index64 controls, arbitrary supported dynamic ancestors and partial calls. Actual combined inner-depth qualification now preserves deeper dynamic bodies, with native checks, fresh replay and real Lean callee/stride refusals. Actual source strides remain known positive. Resource limits apply. Generic runtime data stay arbitrary values; scalar NaN/complex dense literals and normalization-sensitive assembly are excluded. Budgets: raw/query/dense4MiB, syntax/work65536, block4096/depth32. A source outside the bounded Lean profile runs ordinary lowering and is logged unverified at the end, with zero proof credit. Once source-admitted, failed or unavailable checks block compilation.
supported: Word loops: empty, inline, bulk, tails, supported nesting and full contexts. Generic data: exactly one module scf.for, top-level, zero carries, factor2, odd trips>=3, one opaque body event, immediate captured return.
excluded: Generic carried values, additional loops (including opaque regions/other entries), effectful suffixes and multiple body events; source/control/literal forms outside declared bounds.

title: Ordered tiling

7 groups

limit: Depth is selected at the actual tiling stage after unrolling. Public inner TILE and combined UNROLL→TILE gates/native controls pass with exact intermediate/output custody. Retained deeper-body captures are qualified through the controlled auxiliary projection; actual source stride checks remain strict. Private-buffer tiles permit size2–65,536 under a finite resource policy; signed-index64 safety is checked separately. Generic runtime data stay arbitrary values; scalar NaN/complex dense literals and normalization-sensitive assembly are excluded. Budgets: raw/query/dense4MiB, syntax/work65536, block4096/depth32. A source outside the bounded Lean profile runs ordinary lowering and is logged unverified at the end, with zero proof credit. Once source-admitted, failed or unavailable checks block compilation.
supported: Word loops: ordered segments and short final tails, supported selected depths and combined word UNROLL→TILE. Private-buffer initializer tiling; separately qualified generic singleton TILE (exactly one module scf.for, top-level, zero carries, one opaque event, immediate captured return, tile2..65536).
excluded: Generic combined UNROLL→TILE, carried data, extra loops, effectful suffixes and broader generic loop bodies.

title: Private buffer reuse

interface:
Options(buffer_allocator='total_private_unobservable')
--validate-passes buffer_reuse

Allocate A → initialize → use → free
Allocate B → initialize → use → free
→ reuse one private slot for both lifetimes
claim: Equal sets of possible successful public observations under the explicitly selected total, private, unobservable allocator model.
limit: Static rank-two i8/i16/i32/i64 rectangular initialization, sequential disjoint private lifetimes. Untiled and tiled actual outputs have proof routes. Explicit total/private/unobservable allocator; no finite-capacity, complete failure-state or native allocator proof. At the recorded source cut, additive rank-one uniform-seed i32 fixtures passed 33 installed host/compiler/native/replay/mutation cases, including both public routes, fresh-process replay and classified target/component refusals. Default-all memory composition now passes actual untiled and tiled32-tail compiler gates, with a separate complete successful-return/world DCE proof and authentic unchanged CSE observation. Changed memory CSE runs with unverified coverage. Computed prefixes and rank-three source bridges remain engineering. A source outside the bounded Lean profile runs ordinary lowering and is logged unverified at the end, with zero proof credit. Once source-admitted, failed or unavailable checks block compilation.
supported: Static rank-one/rank-two integer views; captured uniform fills; explicit disjoint private lifetimes; untiled or tile2..65536.
excluded: Computed initializer prefixes; rank3+; dynamic/floating storage; escapes/completion. Allocation failures and native allocator fidelity are outside the theorem.

title: Dead-code elimination

%answer = arith.addi %a, %b
return %answer
→ erase %dead

→ the same complete entry without that unused literal.

limit: Only modeled effect-free tensor/scalar operations may be erased. Numerical preparation and native lowering are separate boundaries. The memory rule retains partial actions, casts, dimensions and regions; no categorized-error or divergence equivalence. Actual default-all untiled and tile32-tail routes pass. A source outside the bounded Lean profile runs ordinary lowering and is logged unverified at the end, with zero proof credit. Once source-admitted, failed or unavailable checks block compilation.
supported: Typed tensor rulebook; separate ordinary-memory dead index-constant proof with fitting original index constants/materialized dimensions.
excluded: Unsupported type/op/region rules. Memory categorized errors and divergence are outside its success relation.
